misprints.note: Turned n in the print; the scan clearly shows 'myudighet'.
Two full stops on the baseline; the book's usual separator is '.:'.
The abbreviation full stop after m is missing in the print.

uncertain.note: The iota subscript under ῆ is hard to tell apart from the following raised dot. I kept σχολῇ.
I see no breathings on αύτη or οῦτο (ending forms), so I left them as printed.
The σ in ἐστιν is a blotted, broken letter. The reading is clear from context.
